source: Not recorded: no account here runs into these limits on demand. Built from the source of xai-org/grok-build at 2bdd1d6a, the closest to 1.0.62 it publishes: `handle_sampling_failure` in acp_session_impl/sampler_turn.rs fails `session/prompt` with -32003 after a 429 and with -32603 for an overloaded model once its retries ran out, and sampling/error.rs builds the `data` (a string, or `message` with `http_status`). The bodies after the status line are examples.

freeUsage.data: API error (status 429 Too Many Requests): {"code":"subscription:free-usage-exhausted","error":"You have used the free usage of this period."}

rateLimited.data: API error (status 429 Too Many Requests): {"code":"rate_limit_exceeded","error":"Too many requests."}

data.message: API error (status 400 Bad Request): The prompt is too long.
